Topic 8.5: Play simple

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Play simple. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which is your favourite device cooperatively in pairs and small music?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Play simple
2. Give Kenyan examples for Play simple
3. Practise Play simple at school and at home

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW
